buildCommand: bun run build && bun build ./server/entrypoint.ts --outfile ./server-bundle.js --target node --format esm --packages external
installCommand: npm install --global npm@11.21.2 --no-fund --no-audit && test "$(npm --version)" = "11.21.2" && test "$(npm config get strict-allow-scripts)" = "true" && npm ci --include=dev --no-fund --no-audit
